comments: Child corrects an implicit claim about the spoon and fork by asserting ownership ('es míos').
Child reports inability to place the steering wheel; father's response confirms it's a report of a failed attempt rather than a refusal.
Child confirms the toy does not work in response to Father's question 'no funciona ?' (line 40490).
Child interrupts father's storytelling to take over the role ('no, me'), blocking the father's action.
The token 'na' is a fragment/false start of the word 'nave' (spaceship), not a negation.
Child describes a fact within the play scenario (the ship doesn't work) to explain a character's behavior.
Child corrects the caregiver's claim that Bobi is in the pool (line 57161).
Child reinforces the negative directive to Lila (line 58389, 58392) to stop annoying them; this is a repetition of the sentiment in line 58389.
Child vetoes a proposed placement of a puzzle piece in response to father's question.
The token 'sin' is part of a transcription note [= articula sin voz] describing the child's voice, not a spoken negation.
Child rejects the mother's directive to use the fork (line 96839).
Child repeats refusal to eat more slowly after mother's echo question (line 96914).
Child rejects the parent's command to eat the grapes ('cómetelas') upon realizing they are toys, as evidenced by the parent's immediate explanation that they are toys.
Child denies the father's claim that it is June (line 109334).
The child says 'no' as the dog approaches ([% se le acerca el perro]), functioning as a rejection/blocking of the dog's action.
Child denies the caregiver's claim that the animal is a tiger (line 113690).
Child states they do not know the animal in the book; a factual claim about their state of knowledge.
Child answers a factual question about his preference ("éste no te gusta?"), confirming he does not like the story.
Child corrects caregiver's claim that the animal is a deer (line 113901), stating it is an elephant.
Child denies the caregiver's claim that the animal is a beaver ('un castor se llama ese animal').
Child denies the identification of the animal as a bird, asserting instead that they are elephants.
Child rejects the caregiver's proposal to look at stories ('vamos a_ver estos cuentos') to assert their own agency ('yo veo').
Child answers a factual question about an object's identity by stating they don't know.
Child denies the caregiver's identification of 'tu pelo' and corrects it with 'ésta'.
Child denies father's claim that vultures were big ("eran grandes") and asserts they were small ("pequeños").
Child refuses the request to lend the toy ('préstamelo').
Child states that the uncles (quillis/tíos) are not present.
Child describes play scenario, contrasting placement with line 185290; repeats phrase from 185302.
Child reports that an object does not fit; this is a factual report of difficulty, similar to Example T.
Child is resisting going to the car, as evidenced by 'a coche no' (line 222472) and mother's uptake 'no vamos a subir al coche ahora' (line 222509).
Child opposes going to the car, as confirmed by MOT's follow-up 'no vamos a subir al coche ahora' (line 222509).
Child makes a factual claim that the toy mosquito is no longer falling, confirmed by father's echo 'ya no cae ?'.
Child refuses the mother's directive to lie down and sleep ('échate').
Child asserts that no one is present, following the mother's earlier question 'no hay nadie , hijo ?' (line 447864).
Child notes absence of moon/objects in sky; mother interprets as 'no se vea nada' (nothing is seen).
Child uses 'aquí no' to veto a proposed location or action in response to mother's questions about what they want.
Child answers 'no' to mother's question 'ves?' (do you see?) regarding the chicken being raw.
Child refuses the food the mother is encouraging them to eat, followed by 'vamos' to leave.
Child refuses mother's directive to put the stroller in the house ('mete en casa el carrito').
